text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On our way back after going to buy equipment together with Win Variation.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...? Isn't that—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh, a lottery raffle, huh. Takes me back.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they held it in front of the ballet studio a lot.
So on my way home,
I'd sometimes stop by with my little sisters.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we always ended up getting pocket tissues,
and everyone was so disappointed.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, I mean, huh?
Come to think of it, when we were shopping just now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation rummaged through her
coat pocket, and then...
She suddenly looked up.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I got a lottery ticket...!
choice_data_list: Oh! Since we're here, let's give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
...But I wonder if I can guess it right.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san,
could you spin it in my place?
choice_data_list: Since we have the chance, let's get our revenge.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: A rematch...?
choice_data_list: Next time, we're winning the grand prize, not tissues.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Ahaha...!
Right, from what we were talking about earlier.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The grand prize instead of tissues, huh.
...I see.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, maybe I'll give it a try.
I'm sure it feels great to catch one, right?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, not bad.
You sure know how to hype me up, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Win Variation eagerly spun the raffle wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Eh, wha, what!?
Whoa, whoaaaa...!?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: No way!?
choice_data_list: It's not a lie. Congratulations, Shion!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Aah, thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe... my revenge actually worked...
I really got the special prize...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! By the way, that hot springs ticket
does have an expiration date.
Make sure you don't let it expire!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Hot springs?
...Ah, right, this was a hot springs trip voucher.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
U-Understood. Thank you very much!
Though honestly, it's way too precious to actually use...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I know!
Trainer, if you'd like, with someone—
choice_data_list: No, no, I'd feel terrible taking that!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ugh.
Y... Yeah, you're right... What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, it was decided that the hot springs voucher would be put on display in the Trainer's Room for now.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ......The grand prize, huh.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Sorry, I'm still taking it all in...
To think that someone who always drew pocket tissues could actually win a prize.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Calling it "moving" might be an exaggeration, I guess. It's just a test of luck, after all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Still... thank you for
offering me a chance at a rematch.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that day,
you could catch glimpses of her gazing up at the onsen trip ticket,
basking in the emotion of it all.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I did it...!
Even if it wasn't... the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, that revenge was a total success, right,
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Ehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak"...
Using plenty of top-tier ingredients, straight from
the recipe of a three-star restaurant...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I guess this is a flavor
you don't get to taste very often...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's really huge, isn't it?
Since we have the chance, maybe one more person—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~~~gh!
So thick and juicy...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Too delicious...! Ah, sorry about that,
here I am getting in on what was meant for the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: We couldn't finish it with just the two of us. Plus, I wanted you to have some too, Nature-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "To me? Why—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mmm!? Wait, this half tastes totally different!?
Is this... pepper!? What flavor is this!?
I have no idea, but it's soo good!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa, even the carrots have this subtle, refined sweetness~.
How do you even simmer them to turn out like this~? So good, thank you~.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I just had a feeling I'd get to see a wonderful reaction.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I also whipped up some pot-au-feu and carrot rappé.
Would you like some?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, obviously I'm gonna eat it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Win Variation happily watched over Nice Nature as she relished every bite.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Second prize...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, but... I'm really happy!
At least it's better than pocket tissues.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's an incredible amount.
I wonder if we can finish it all...
Maybe we should give some to someone with a big appetite—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello?
Did the carrots arrive, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Shion's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Thanks a bunch.
That really helps me out."

text_block_list.name: Shion's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Those kids have been eating more and more lately, no matter how many ingredients we have, it's never enough."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's great. Tell him to eat plenty
and grow nice and big, alright?

text_block_list.name: Shion's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...That's true. I could tell them myself,
but it'd be nice if you did once in a while too, Shion."

text_block_list.name: Shion's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Come visit anytime for a breather, okay?
I'll make something delicious and wait for you."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, thanks, Mom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Win Variation continued to enjoy talking with her family on the phone for a while.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Th-Third... place...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"This is...
cutting it razor-thin, huh...?"
choice_data_list: Well, even so, 3rd prize is still 3rd prize.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. My apologies,
that was disrespectful to the 3rd prize. I will gladly
accept this single carrot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after that, when I took the single carrot
back to the Trainer's Room—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grind, grind, grind, grind...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, all done.
My special carrot-apple juice, that is.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I should accept this 3rd prize with gratitude
and keep doing my best starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Now then, cheers, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the carrot apple juice we drank after that
was sweet, rich, and had a hint of bitterness.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...A-Ahaha. I'm sorry.
It didn't work out after all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... ngh.
Y-You're right. I can't let myself get discouraged...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"If I get another chance, next time for sure...!
Next time, I'm getting that grand prize...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, Win Variation still seemed
to look just a little downcast."
